name: Raking
description: A raking light: parallel bars whose lean builds steadily down the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: -20%; width: 48%; height: 140%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: skewX(@calc(-42 + 84 * @y / @Y)deg); transform: skewX(@calc(-42 + 84 * @y / @Y)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
